articles.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Morgan Stanley maintains underweight on Dixon; Citi cuts target price on IndiGo
articles.description: Brokerage houses remain selective on Indian equities, with Morgan Stanley maintaining an underweight call on Dixon Technologies due to PLI uncertainties. Citi retained a Buy on IndiGo but cut its target price amid cost pressures and geopolitical disruptions, while Motilal Oswal sees strong upside in Maruti Suzuki supported by product launches and exports.
articles.body: Brokerages continue to remain selective in their outlook on Indian equities, highlighting company-specific drivers ranging from policy changes and cost pressures to product pipelines and market share recovery.Recent notes from global and domestic brokerages such as Morgan Stanley, Citi, and Motilal Oswal reflect a mixed stance across sectors including electronics manufacturing, aviation, and automobiles.While some analysts remain cautious due to
